# Redaction only — not a successful git clone.
# Password itself contains @; mask via last @ → http://***@host/...
# Wrong password → 401. useExecLogs=true while asserting fragments absent.

git-authfail-start

cp .apinfra.secret .apinfra

exec apinfra
stderr 'http://\*\*\*@'
! stderr 'SecAtLeft99'
! stderr 'SecAtRight99'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' SecAtLeft99 $HOME
! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' SecAtRight99 $HOME

git-authfail-stop

-- .apinfra.secret --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
repo=http://git:SecAtLeft99@SecAtRight99@127.0.0.1:18081/repo
useExecLogs=true

-- .env --
